what: Unified Plotting Primitives for Base Graphics and ggplot2
title: Unified Plotting Primitives for Base Graphics and ggplot2
text: dualplot provides unified, lightweight set 2D plotting primitives render seamlessly either Base R graphics (engine = "graphics") ggplot2 (engine = "ggplot2"). Designed zero-heavy-dependency visualization backend statistical machine learning packages (midr), dualplot keeps ggplot2 strictly Suggests offering bidirectional aesthetic translation, unified legends, clean monograph styling across backends.

title: Unified Plotting Primitives for Base Graphics and ggplot2
text: can install development version dualplot GitHub :
code: # install.packages("pak") pak::pak("ryo-asashi/dualplot")

title: Unified Plotting Primitives for Base Graphics and ggplot2
text: six plotting primitives share consistent interface (theme, theme.values, legend, legend.title, engine, ...):

title: Unified Plotting Primitives for Base Graphics and ggplot2
code: library(dualplot)  effects <- c(Age = 0.42, Income = -0.60, Tenure = 0.68, Region = -0.36) cm <- cor(mtcars[, 1:5])  # 1. Base R graphics (zero ggplot2 dependency) old_par <- par_monograph(mfrow = c(1, 2)) draw_bars(   effects,   theme = "Zissou 1",   xlab = "Contribution",   legend = "right",   legend.title = "Effect",   engine = "graphics" ) draw_matrix(   cm,   theme = "Cividis",   xlab = "Correlation",   legend = "right",   legend.title = "Corr",   engine = "graphics" ) par(old_par) # 2. Switch seamlessly to ggplot2 library(ggplot2) #> Warning: package 'ggplot2' was built under R version 4.5.3 library(patchwork) p1 <- draw_bars(   effects,   theme = "Zissou 1",   xlab = "Contribution",   legend = "right",   legend.title = "Effect",   engine = "ggplot2" ) +   theme_monograph(grid.type = "x") p2 <- draw_matrix(   cm,   theme = "Cividis",   xlab = "Correlation",   legend = "right",   legend.title = "Corr",   engine = "ggplot2" ) +   theme_monograph() p1 + p2

title: Unified Plotting Primitives for Base Graphics and ggplot2
text: Engine selection: Set default rendering backend globally via dualplot_options(engine = "ggplot2") dualplot_options(engine = "graphics"). Default ggplot2 theme: Attach default theme automatically ggplot2 outputs via dualplot_options(gg.theme = theme_monograph()). Unified parameter translation: Pass either Base R (col, pch, cex, lty, lwd, main) ggplot2 (colour, shape, size, linetype, linewidth, title) aesthetic arguments draw_*() function; dualplot translates filters automatically active backend. Unified legends: Control legend visibility placement across engines using legend = TRUE / FALSE, inside corners ("topright", "topleft", "bottomright", "bottomleft"), outside margins ("top", "bottom", "left", "right").
